text: fix(config): ci.yml pull_request paths-ignore (.backlogit, docs, .autoharness, *.md) means docs/backlog-only PRs never run the CI workflow, so the 'Detect code changes' job (the paths-filter detector) never reports. CURRENT CONTEXT (2026-07-10): operator set ruleset PR-Required required_status_checks=[], so this no longer BLOCKS merges today (backlog/docs PRs merge CLEAN). LATENT: if required checks are re-added, docs/backlog PRs would again leave the required check pending. Fix if/when required checks return: remove paths-ignore from the pull_request trigger so 'changes' always runs; the 'Build, vet, lint & test' job already self-gates via if needs.changes.outputs.code==true + the dorny/paths-filter denylist, so it stays skipped for backlog-only diffs. Low priority while required_checks=[].

DEFERRED SCOPE EXPANSION. Expansion: add an optional production browser executable-path (ExecPath) so the deployed bot launches on Edge-only / non-PATH hosts without a manual PATH prepend. Out of scope per P-021 C1: this is a DIFFERENT CONTRACT SURFACE from feature 010-F -- runtime deployment portability of the PRODUCTION launcher (ChromeRunner.run in internal/browser/runner.go and NewLiveMeeting in internal/browser/meeting.go, which build the chromedp allocator via browser.AllocatorOptions(...) with NO exec-path option), not the live selector/join-path hardening + verification that 010-F authorizes. U7 / task 010.007-T deliberately adds an ExecPath override to the integration TEST harness ONLY, so completing production ExecPath is NOT the same authorized change. Same subsystem (internal/browser) and related are explicitly insufficient scope tests under C1, and genuine ambiguity resolves OUT of scope. Source refs (availability judged INDEPENDENTLY PER FIELD): PR number N/A (no PR opened); review-thread ID N/A (surfaced in Stage local review / Scope Boundary Auditor pass 2026-09-05, not a PR review thread); task ID 010.007-T; feature ID 010-F; shipment ID 010-S; plan docs/plans/2026-09-05-teams-live-selector-path-hardening-plan.md (U7 scope-boundary note); source files internal/browser/runner.go and internal/browser/meeting.go. requires deliberation: YES (P-021 C6 -- a distinct feature requiring a design decision: a browser.Options.ExecPath field plus config/env plumbing and production launch policy, not a mechanical fix). Kind: feature. Provisional priority: medium. Signature-parity note: the production abort signature is exec: google-chrome executable file not found in %PATH% -- the SAME chromedp PATH-discovery signature U7 fixes for the harness only; it is DISTINCT from the managed agent-browser DevToolsActivePort launch failure and the two failure signatures MUST NOT be conflated.
